mechanism: normal /v1/chat/completions requests acquire the per-session gate and may persist session/tool state near completion
a reset/clear command can therefore clear state and acknowledge success while an older same-session request is still running
the older request may subsequently persist its accepted state again, resurrecting a session after reset acknowledgement
minimal_fix_contract: serialize session-mutating commands under the same SessionRequestGate used by ordinary requests
do not acknowledge reset/clear until all older same-session requests have left the gate and the clear has durably completed
add a regression where an old request pauses before persistence, reset starts, old request completes, reset then clears; final durable session must be absent
scope: No product source changed. No hosted CI, provider traffic, real accounts, secrets, Cloudflare, Windows, production, Kontur product, or AI Mirrors touched.
